what: This is the ordinary share class of Banco Bradesco, one of Brazil's largest private banks. The bank serves tens of millions of customers through branches and digital channels and owns Bradesco Seguros, the country's biggest insurer.
customers: Brazilian households, small and medium businesses, corporations, and insurance policyholders.
money: deposits, cards, personal and business lending
Bradesco Seguros life, health and general insurance
moat: A branch and agent network reaching deep into Brazil, including places digital banks do not serve, plus the largest insurance operation in the country.
risks: Credit losses rose sharply in recent years, more than at its main rival
Digital banks have taken share in payments and cards
Brazilian rates and unemployment drive loan performance
Its branch cost base is heavy relative to digital competitors
opportunities: The insurance business earns steady profits independent of lending
Brazilian credit penetration is still low relative to developed markets
Cost reduction and branch closures are improving efficiency
watch: The non-performing loan ratio and return on equity against Itaú.
